mar_agent_models:
CREATE TABLE `mar_agent_models` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `normalized_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `protocol` enum('OPENAI_RESPONSES','ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES') NOT NULL,
  `base_url` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `credential` json NOT NULL,
  `model_id` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `context_window_tokens` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `max_output_tokens` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `input_capabilities` json NOT NULL,
  `output_capabilities` json NOT NULL,
  `reasoning_efforts` json NOT NULL,
  `default_reasoning_effort` enum('low','medium','high','xhigh','max','ultra') NOT NULL,
  `title_generation` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `code_mode` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `high_density_compaction` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `fast_mode` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `hosted_web_search` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `responses_transport` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `responses_previous_response_id` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `last_tested_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_test_status` enum('UNVERIFIED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED',
  `last_test_code` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `responses_encoding` enum('STANDARD','LITE') DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `mar_agent_models_directory` (`enabled`,`sort_order`,`normalized_name`),
  KEY `mar_agent_models_creator_fk` (`created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `mar_agent_models_creator_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mar_agent_models_limits` CHECK (((`context_window_tokens` > `max_output_tokens`) and (`max_output_tokens` > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
